runs.answer: BEST CHOICE: Suno ($10/month or $96/year). BIGGEST RISK: Suno's terms page explicitly states "Our terms are changing soon" with new terms dated March 26, 2026—meaning the commercial rights you depend on today could be modified or revoked after purchase. runs.title: Pick a transcription tool for 20 interviews
runs.prompt: A local journalist has 20 recorded interviews, about 45 minutes each, already saved as audio files. She needs accurate transcripts with speaker labels, and she cares that recordings are not used to train models. Using only public pages on otter.ai, fireflies.ai, and descript.com, compare: cheapest paid plan price monthly and annual, how many minutes or hours of transcription that plan includes and any per-file length limit, whether uploading existing audio files is allowed on that plan (versus live meeting recording only), speaker identification support, export formats, and what each company's public privacy or security page says about using customer audio for model training. Recommend one, with a one-paragraph justification and any deal-breaker you found.
runs.answer:
**Recommendation: Fireflies.ai**

Fireflies.ai is the best choice for this journalist because it explicitly states "Zero Data Retention - Your data is never used for AI training or any purpose outside your direct business needs," directly addressing her primary concern about protecting her recordings from being used for model training. All three services support uploading pre-recorded audio files, speaker identification, and multiple export formats. However, Fireflies' clear, unambiguous privacy commitment regarding zero use of customer data for AI training is a critical differentiator. While I was unable to extract complete pricing tables from the public pages due to content pruning (the specific monthly/annual costs, minute allowances, and per-file limits were not fully readable), Fireflies' explicit data protection policy makes it the clear winner for a journalist concerned about interview confidentiality and avoiding her content being used to train third-party AI models. This is a deal-breaker requirement for her use case, and Fireflies is the only service that explicitly guarantees this protection on their public-facing security page.
